compiled:
📰 General

College Basketball Rankings Remain Static Despite Tuesday Night’s Loaded Schedule •

The CBS Sports Top 25 And 1 college basketball rankings maintained their positions following Tuesday’s action. Despite a highly competitive slate of games featuring matchups between Michigan State and Tennessee, as well as Duke and Illinois, no teams experienced movement in the poll. The rankings reflect the current performance and perceived strength of the top programs in NCAA men’s basketball. This stability suggests a tightly contested race for the top spots heading into the remainder of the season.

🌍 World

Washington Man Survives Hippo Attack on Honeymoon, Wife’s Intervention Critical •

A Washington man was severely injured after being disemboweled by a hippopotamus during a safari trip in Africa. The incident occurred while the couple was on their honeymoon, with the man sustaining significant abdominal trauma. His wife intervened by punching the animal, disrupting the attack and allowing medical personnel to reach him. Emergency responders transported the man to a local hospital for treatment, and his condition is currently unknown.

🦅 US

Ukraine Claims Responsibility for Kerch Bridge Attack, Marking a Significant Blow to Russia •

Ukrainian forces conducted a drone attack on the Kerch Bridge early Monday evening, resulting in significant damage to the structure. A Ukrainian soldier deployed a kamikaze drone bearing the message “The bridge is fucked,” prior to the attack. The bridge, a critical transportation link connecting Russia to annexed Crimea, sustained substantial damage from multiple explosions. Russian officials confirmed the attack, attributing it to Ukrainian forces and characterizing it as a blow to Moscow’s strategic interests.

💰 Business

Anthropic’s IPO Soars Above Initial Price Amidst Robust Investor Demand •

Anthropic, the artificial intelligence company, is pursuing an initial public offering (IPO) with a proposed price range of $80 to $85 per share. Initial indications suggest strong investor interest, with the company aiming to price the offering above its previously stated range. The IPO is expected to raise approximately $700 million at the higher end of the proposed range. This valuation reflects the growing excitement surrounding Anthropic’s advancements in generative AI technology.

💻 Technology

Nintendo Switch 2 Console Drops to $407 on AliExpress During Black Friday •

The Nintendo Switch 2 console is currently available for purchase on AliExpress for $407. Originally slated for a MSRP of $450, the console’s price increased to $500 following a recent price hike by Nintendo. This sale represents a significant discount on the new console, making it an attractive upgrade option for Switch owners. The deal is available as part of the ongoing Black Friday sales event.

🎭 Entertainment

Mariah Carey’s Twins Share Stark Revelation About Nick Cannon in New Trailer •

In a new Netflix trailer for a documentary focusing on Nick Cannon, his eldest children, Moroccan and Monroe, offered a candid assessment of his relationship with Mariah Carey. The 15-year-old twins described their mother as “the best” and expressed a clear preference for her over their father. This marks a rare public comment from the twins regarding their family dynamic. The documentary will explore Nick Cannon’s life and family, featuring interviews and personal insights.

🏅 Sports

Kings Face Bruins in Regular Season Opener, Gustafsson Returns to Ice •

The Los Angeles Kings will begin their 2026-27 NHL regular season against the Boston Bruins on Tuesday, November 17th. This game marks the anticipated return of defenseman Anze Kopitar, who is expected to lead the Kings’ lineup. The matchup will be held at TD Garden in Boston, Massachusetts, with a 4:00 PM Pacific Time start. Analysts are focusing on the Kings’ power play strategies and the historical context of overtime periods.

🔬 Science

Curiosity Rover Uncovers Mysterious “Potato Chip” Formations on Mars •

NASA scientists are currently examining unusual, irregularly shaped rock formations discovered by the Curiosity rover on Mars. These formations resemble “potato chips” and are prompting investigation into their origin and composition. The rover’s investigation focuses on determining the geological processes that created these unique shapes. Scientists are analyzing the rocks for clues about past Martian environments and potential evidence of water activity. This discovery adds to the ongoing research into Mars’s geological history.

🩺 Health

Loyola Medicine Restricts Hospital Visitors to Those 18 and Older Due to Virus Surge •

Loyola Medicine is implementing a new policy limiting hospital visitors to individuals aged 18 and older. The change is attributed to a significant rise in respiratory virus infections within the hospital system. Medical staff reports a notable increase in cases of influenza, RSV, and other viral illnesses. The restriction is intended to protect vulnerable patients and reduce the spread of infection throughout the facility.
